rules.source: Loi n° 2010/012 relative à la cybersécurité et la cybercriminalité — https://cyrilla.org/en/entity/oem17trmwp
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: governs security of electronic communication networks and information systems, defines and punishes ICT-related offences; covers electronic evidence, cryptography and e-certification; liability exemption for technical intermediaries conditional on prompt removal of known illicit content. Sources date it 21 December 2010 (one says 2 December).

rules.source: Loi n° 2024/017 du 23 décembre 2024 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel — https://droitmediasfinance.com/index.php/actualites/droit-tech-fintech/1297-cameroun-la-loi-sur-la-protection-des-donnees-a-caractere-personnel-entre-en-vigueur-ce-23-juin-2026
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: promulgated 23 December 2024, creates the Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel (APDP); restricts cross-border transfers (equivalent protection and prior authorization); 18-month grace period, reported in force 23 June 2026; implementing decrees not verified.
